name: @hatch/space-sdk
description: Standalone replacement for the Muse platform SDK (@hatch/space-sdk). Same public surface the ViceSunshine code imports — defineAction, z, createActionClient, spaceQueryClient, fileToBase64, actionFields, buildClient — re-implemented on plain HTTP + Bun SQLite. This is NOT the Muse SDK; it only exists so the copied ViceSunshine source can run outside Muse without changing its logic.
